blocks.text: will: qaror shu yerda, hozir qabul qilinadi

**will** (qisqasi **'ll**, inkori **won't**) qizil kitobda kelajak zamon shakli sifatida o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 27–28-darslar). Bu darsda will ning **muloqotdagi vazifalariga** to'xtalamiz: gapirayotgan paytdagi qaror, taklif, rozilik, va'da, iltimos va rad etish. Bu holatlarda will — shunchaki «kelajak» emas, balki **hozirgi munosabat**: I**'ll** help you — «Yordam beraman» (hozir shunga qaror qildim). Kelajak haqida taxmin (It will be cold tomorrow) — keyingi darsda (→ 22-dars).

rows: The phone's ringing. — I**'ll get** it.
That looks heavy. I**'ll carry** it.
— Can you help me? — OK, I**'ll** help.

blocks.text: Shu zahoti qaror: I'll ... / I think I'll ...

**I'll** — qarorni **aynan gapirayotgan paytda**, vaziyatga javoban qabul qilganimizda: It's cold. — I**'ll close** the window. Qaror endi tug'ilayotganini ko'pincha **I think I'll ...** («...sam kerak», «...a qolay») va **I don't think I'll ...** («...masam kerak») iboralari bildiradi. Agar qaror **oldin** qabul qilingan bo'lsa, will emas — **going to** (→ 20-dars) yoki **Present Continuous** (→ 19-dars) kerak. O'zbekchada farq ko'pincha so'zlarda ko'rinadi: «**unda** ...aman», «**mayli**, ...aman» — will; «...**moqchiman**», «...ishga **qaror qilganman**» — going to.

rows: — There's no bread. — Oh, I**'ll buy** some.
— There's no bread. — I know, I**'m going to** buy some.
— Tom phoned. — OK, I**'ll call** him back.
I**'m calling** Tom at six — we arranged it.
Hmm, I think I**'ll have** the soup.
I've decided — I**'m going to** order the soup.

items.text: I'm tired. **I think I'll** stay in tonight.
It's raining! **I'll take** a taxi, then.
**I don't think I'll** go to the gym today.

blocks.text: **Taklif**: biror ishni o'zimiz bajarishga chiqamiz — That bag looks heavy. I**'ll help** you with it (o'zbekchada «**...ib beraman**», «**...ishib yuboraman**»). **Rozilik**: kimningdir so'roviga «mayli» deymiz — Can you give me a lift? — Sure, I**'ll** drop you at the station. **Va'da**: I**'ll** call you tonight; I **won't** be late; I promise I**'ll** pay you back. Og'zaki nutqda odatda qisqa **'ll** ishlatiladi; to'liq **I will** — qat'iyatni kuchaytirish uchun: I **will** finish it, I promise!

items.text: Sit down — **I'll make** you a cup of tea.
items.translation: O'tiring — sizga bir piyola **choy damlab beraman**.

items.text: — Can you check my essay? — Of course, **I'll** do it tonight.
items.translation: — Inshoimni tekshirib bera olasanmi? — Albatta, bugun kechqurun **tekshiraman**.

items.text: **I won't** forget your birthday again, I promise.

blocks.text: Will you ...? — iltimos; won't — rad etish

**Will you ...?** — kimdandir biror ishni qilishni so'rash: **Will** you **post** this letter for me? U biroz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri eshitiladi; xushmuomalaroq shakllar — Could you ...? / Would you ...? (→ 37-dars). **won't** — rad etish, «ko'nmaslik»: She **won't** answer my calls (javob berishni istamayapti). Bu narsalar haqida ham ishlatiladi: The car **won't** start, The door **won't** open. E'tibor bering: o'zbekchada bu yerda hozirgi zamon — «mashina **o't olmayapti**», «eshik **ochilmayapti**», inglizchada esa won't.

**shall** hozirgi Britaniya ingliz tilida asosan **I** va **we** bilan savolda ishlatiladi. **Shall I ...?** — xizmat taklif qilish, o'zbekcha «**...aymi?**»: **Shall I** turn on the heating? **Shall we ...?** — birgalikda biror ish qilishni taklif qilish, «**...aylikmi?**»: **Shall we** go for a walk? **What / Where / When shall I / we ...?** — maslahat yoki qaror so'rash, «**nima ...sam ekan?**»: What **shall** I **cook** tonight? **Let's ..., shall we?** — taklifni yumshatadi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I bought the ticket last week. I will go to Samarkand tomorrow» → I**'m going** to Samarkand tomorrow (qaror oldin qilingan); «The phone's ringing — I answer it» → I**'ll answer** it; «Will I open the window?» (taklif) → **Shall I** open the window?; «Shall you help me?» → **Will** you help me?; «I promise I call you» → I promise I**'ll call** you; bir necha urinishdan keyin «The car doesn't start» → The car **won't start**.

Amerika ingliz tilida shall juda kam ishlatiladi: Shall I ...? o'rniga **Should I ...?** yoki **Do you want me to ...?** deyiladi. Britaniyada **I shall / we shall** darak gapda ham bor, lekin rasmiy va kam uchraydi (→ qizil kitob, 27-dars).

Tarjima kaliti: «**...aymi?**» → Shall I ...?; «**...aylikmi?**» → Shall we ...?; «**unda / mayli, ...aman**» → I'll ...; «**...masam kerak**» → I don't think I'll ...; «ko'nmayapti, **...mayapti**» (rad etish) → won't.

rows: I**'ll** help you. I **won't** tell anyone.

examples.title: Deciding on the spot: **I'll** ...
examples.description: Qaror gapirayotgan paytda, vaziyatga javoban qabul qilinadi: I'll (= I will) + V1. O'zbekchada «unda ...aman», «mayli, ...a qolay».

sentences.text: The phone's ringing — don't get up, **I'll answer** it.
sentences.translation: Telefon jiringlayapti — turmang, **o'zim olaman**.

sentences.text: Oh no, I've left my keys in the car! **I'll go** and get them.
sentences.translation: Voy, kalitlarimni mashinada qoldiribman! **Borib olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: It's cold in here, isn't it? **I'll close** the window.
sentences.translation: Bu yer sovuq, shundaymi? **Derazani yopaman**.

sentences.text: The fish looks good — **I'll have** the salmon, please.
sentences.translation: Baliq yaxshi ko'rinyapti — menga **losos bo'lsin**, iltimos.

sentences.text: Is the shop closed? Then **we'll buy** bread at the bazaar instead.
sentences.translation: Do'kon yopiqmi? Unda nonni bozordan **olamiz**.

sentences.text: You're tired, so **I'll drive** the rest of the way.
sentences.translation: Sen charchading, qolgan yo'lni **men haydayman**.

sentences.text: Nobody has answered my email, so **I'll phone** them instead.
sentences.translation: Xatimga hech kim javob bermadi, unda **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: Wait, Aziz! **I'll come** with you — I need some fresh air too.
sentences.translation: To'xta, Aziz! **Sen bilan boraman** — menga ham toza havo kerak.

sentences.text: These shoes are perfect. **I'll take** them, and could I have a bag too?
sentences.translation: Bu tufli juda mos. **Shuni olaman**, menga paket ham bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Did you say Emma's in hospital? **I'll visit** her after work today.
sentences.translation: Emma kasalxonada dedingmi? Bugun ishdan keyin **uni ko'rgani boraman**.

examples.title: **I think I'll** ... / **I don't think I'll** ...
examples.description: Qaror endi qabul qilinayotganda ko'pincha I think I'll ... («...sam kerak», «...a qolay») va I don't think I'll ... («...masam kerak») deyiladi.

sentences.text: I'm exhausted. **I think I'll** go to bed early tonight.
sentences.translation: Holdan toydim. Bugun **erta yotsam kerak**.

sentences.text: **I don't think I'll** come to the party — I've got an exam on Monday.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga **kelmasam kerak** — dushanba kuni imtihonim bor.

sentences.text: It's such a lovely day! **I think I'll** walk to work.
sentences.translation: Bugun shunday ajoyib kun! Ishga **piyoda bora qolay**.

sentences.text: That soup was delicious — **I think I'll** have some more.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva juda mazali ekan — **yana biroz olsam kerak**.

sentences.text: Jasur checked the price and sighed, '**I don't think I'll** buy it after all.'
sentences.translation: Jasur narxiga qaradi-da, xo'rsindi: «Baribir **olmasam kerak**.»

sentences.text: Hmm, the queue is too long. **I think I'll** come back tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Hmm, navbat juda uzun. **Ertaga kela qolay**.

sentences.text: Kate's not answering, so **I think I'll** leave her a message.
sentences.translation: Keyt javob bermayapti, **unga xabar qoldirsam kerak**.

sentences.text: Since the film has terrible reviews, **I don't think we'll** bother going.
sentences.translation: Film haqida sharhlar juda yomon, shuning uchun **bormasak kerak**.

sentences.text: My back hurts after that walk; **I don't think I'll** play football on Sunday.
sentences.translation: O'sha yurishdan keyin belim og'riyapti, yakshanba kuni **futbol o'ynamasam kerak**.

sentences.text: Thanks for the offer, but **I think I'll** stay at home this evening and read.
sentences.translation: Taklifingiz uchun rahmat, lekin bugun kechqurun **uyda qolib, kitob o'qiy qolay**.

examples.title: Decided now or before? **I'll** / **I'm going to**
examples.description: will — qaror shu zahoti; going to yoki Present Continuous — qaror oldin qabul qilingan (→ 19–20-darslar). Juft vaziyatlar.

sentences.text: — We haven't got any milk. — Oh, really? **I'll get** some on my way home.
sentences.translation: — Sutimiz yo'q. — Rostdanmi? Uyga qaytayotib **olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: — We haven't got any milk. — I know. **I'm going to** get some later.
sentences.translation: — Sutimiz yo'q. — Bilaman. Keyinroq **olib kelmoqchiman**.

sentences.text: — Tom called while you were out. — Thanks, **I'll call** him back now.
sentences.translation: — Sen yo'qligingda Tom qo'ng'iroq qildi. — Rahmat, hozir **o'zim qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: — Why are you wearing a suit? — **I'm meeting** an important client at two.
sentences.translation: — Nega kostyum kiyding? — Soat ikkida muhim mijoz bilan **uchrashaman**.

sentences.text: I've decided: **I'm going to** take that job in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Qaror qildim: Edinburgdagi o'sha ishni **qabul qilaman**.

sentences.text: Is that job in Edinburgh still available? Great — **I'll apply** for it today.
sentences.translation: Edinburgdagi o'sha ish hali ham bo'shmi? Zo'r — bugun **ariza topshiraman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is having** her hair cut tomorrow; she booked it a week ago.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ertaga **soch oldiryapti** — bir hafta oldin yozilib qo'ygan.

sentences.text: Your hair looks long — **I'll book** you an appointment with my hairdresser if you like.
sentences.translation: Sochingiz o'sib qolibdi — xohlasangiz, sartaroshimga **yozib qo'yaman**.

sentences.text: Madina can't come tonight? In that case, **we'll** have to change the plan.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kela olmaydimi? Unda rejani **o'zgartirishimizga to'g'ri keladi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has already decided what to do: **he's going to** study in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bekzod nima qilishini allaqachon hal qilib qo'ygan: Manchesterda **o'qimoqchi**.

examples.title: Offering and agreeing: **I'll** help you
examples.description: Taklif — yordam berishga o'zingiz chiqasiz («...ib beraman»). Rozilik — kimningdir so'roviga «mayli, ...aman» deb javob berish.

sentences.text: That suitcase looks heavy. **I'll carry** it up the stairs for you.
sentences.translation: Bu chamadon og'ir ko'rinadi. Zinadan **ko'tarib chiqib beraman**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about dinner — **I'll cook** tonight.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat haqida xavotir olma — bugun **men pishiraman**.

sentences.text: — Can you lend me your charger? — Of course, **I'll bring** it tomorrow.
sentences.translation: — Quvvatlagichingni berib tura olasanmi? — Albatta, ertaga **olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: If you're busy, **I'll pick** the kids up from school.
sentences.translation: Agar band bo'lsang, bolalarni maktabdan **men olib kelaman**.

sentences.text: — The printer's not working again. — Leave it to me, **I'll fix** it.
sentences.translation: — Printer yana ishlamayapti. — Menga qo'yib ber, **tuzataman**.

sentences.text: — Could you help me with this report? — Sure, **I'll have** a look after lunch.
sentences.translation: — Shu hisobotda yordam bera olasizmi? — Albatta, tushlikdan keyin **ko'rib chiqaman**.

sentences.text: Sit down and relax — **we'll** do the washing-up.
sentences.translation: O'tiring, dam oling — idishlarni **biz yuvamiz**.

sentences.text: You don't know the way? No problem, **I'll show** you on the map.
sentences.translation: Yo'lni bilmaysizmi? Muammo yo'q, xaritada **ko'rsatib beraman**.

sentences.text: — Is it OK if I pay you next week? — Fine, **I'll wait**.
sentences.translation: — Kelasi hafta to'lasam bo'ladimi? — Mayli, **kutaman**.

sentences.text: Jasur offered to help: '**I'll drive** you to the airport — it's on my way.'
sentences.translation: Jasur yordam taklif qildi: «Seni aeroportga **olib boraman** — yo'limda.»

examples.title: Promises: **I'll** ... / **I won't** ...
examples.description: Va'da — I'll ..., I won't ..., I promise I'll ... O'zbekchada «...aman», «...mayman», «so'z beraman».

sentences.text: Thanks for the loan — **I'll pay** you back on Friday, I promise.
sentences.translation: Qarz uchun rahmat — juma kuni **qaytaraman**, so'z beraman.

sentences.text: Your secret is safe with me. **I won't tell** anyone.
sentences.translation: Siring menda saqlanadi. Hech kimga **aytmayman**.

sentences.text: I promise **I'll be** home before midnight, Mum.
sentences.translation: So'z beraman, oyi, yarim tungacha **uyda bo'laman**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, **I won't forget** to water your plants while you're away.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olma, sen yo'qligingda gullaringni sug'orishni **unutmayman**.

sentences.text: **I'll** never **do** that again — I'm really sorry.
sentences.translation: Boshqa hech qachon **bunday qilmayman** — rostdan ham kechiring.

sentences.text: The minister promised that taxes **won't go up** this year.
sentences.translation: Vazir bu yil soliqlar **oshmasligiga** va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Kate, **will** you **promise** to call me as soon as you land?
sentences.translation: Keyt, qo'nishing bilan menga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **va'da berasanmi**?

sentences.text: We**'ll** definitely **send** you photos from the wedding!
sentences.translation: To'ydan suratlarni albatta **yuboramiz**!

sentences.text: Bekzod has promised he**'ll** never **be** late for work again.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishga boshqa hech qachon **kechikmasligiga** va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Trust me — this time **I won't let** you down.
sentences.translation: Menga ishon — bu safar **umidingni puchga chiqarmayman**.

examples.title: Requests and refusals: **Will you** ...? / **won't**
examples.description: Will you ...? — kimdandir biror ishni so'rash (biroz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri). won't — rad etish, ko'nmaslik; narsalar haqida ham: The car won't start — «o't olmayapti».

sentences.text: **Will you** turn the music down, please? I'm trying to work.
sentences.translation: Musiqani **pasaytirib qo'yasanmi**, iltimos? Ishlashga harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: **Will you** marry me, Nilufar? — Yes, of course I **will**!
sentences.translation: Nilufar, menga **turmushga chiqasanmi**? — Ha, albatta **chiqaman**!

sentences.text: The car **won't start** — I think the battery is dead.
sentences.translation: Mashina **o't olmayapti** — menimcha, akkumulyator o'tirib qolgan.

sentences.text: I've asked Tom many times, but he **won't listen** to my advice.
sentences.translation: Tomga ko'p marta aytdim, lekin u maslahatimga **quloq solmaydi**.

sentences.text: My daughter **won't eat** anything green, not even cucumbers.
sentences.translation: Qizim yashil narsani **yemaydi**, hatto bodringni ham.

sentences.text: This old window **won't open**, however hard I push it.
sentences.translation: Bu eski deraza qanchalik itarsam ham **ochilmayapti**.

sentences.text: Hold the door for me, **will you**? My hands are full.
sentences.translation: Eshikni ushlab **turasanmi**? Qo'lim band.

sentences.text: The bank **won't give** us a loan because we haven't got a regular income.
sentences.translation: Doimiy daromadimiz yo'qligi uchun bank bizga **kredit bermayapti**.

sentences.text: Aziz is angry with his brother and **won't speak** to him.
sentences.translation: Aziz akasidan xafa va u bilan **gaplashmayapti**.

sentences.text: Please **will** everyone **switch** their phones off before the concert begins?
sentences.translation: Konsert boshlanishidan oldin hamma telefonini **o'chirib qo'ysin**, iltimos.

examples.title: **Shall I** ...? **Shall we** ...? What **shall** we ...?
examples.description: shall faqat I va we bilan savolda: taklif (Shall I ...? — «...aymi?»), birgalikdagi taklif (Shall we ...? — «...aylikmi?»), maslahat so'rash (What shall I ...? — «nima ...sam ekan?»).

sentences.text: **Shall I** open the window? It's really stuffy in here.
sentences.translation: **Derazani ochaymi**? Bu yer juda dim.

sentences.text: It's a lovely evening. **Shall we** eat outside on the terrace?
sentences.translation: Ajoyib oqshom. Ayvonda **ovqatlanaylikmi**?

sentences.text: What **shall** I **wear** to the interview — a suit or something more casual?
sentences.translation: Suhbatga nima **kiysam ekan** — kostyummi yoki oddiyroq narsami?

sentences.text: Where **shall** we **go** for our anniversary this year, Samarkand or Khiva?
sentences.translation: Bu yil to'y yilligimizga qayerga **boraylik** — Samarqandgami yoki Xivagami?

sentences.text: **Shall I** call you a taxi, or would you prefer to walk?
sentences.translation: Sizga **taksi chaqirib beraymi** yoki piyoda yurishni afzal ko'rasizmi?

sentences.text: Let's take a break, **shall we**? We've been working since eight.
sentences.translation: Keling, **tanaffus qilaylik**, a? Soat sakkizdan beri ishlayapmiz.

sentences.text: The boss isn't answering. What **shall** we **do** about the contract?
sentences.translation: Boshliq javob bermayapti. Shartnoma bo'yicha nima **qilamiz**?

sentences.text: **Shall we** invite Sarah and Oliver to dinner on Friday?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Sara va Oliverni kechki ovqatga **taklif qilaylikmi**?

sentences.text: These bags are full. **Shall I** take some of them for you?
sentences.translation: Bu sumkalar to'la. Ulardan **ba'zilarini olaymi**?

sentences.text: How much **shall** we **leave** as a tip, do you think?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, choychaqaga qancha **qoldiramiz**?

examples.title: Dialogue: a crisis at the office
examples.description: Mijoz kelishidan oldin ofisda muammo: will (qaror, taklif, va'da), Will you ...?, won't va Shall I / Shall we ...? bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Oh no, the printer **won't work**, and the client is arriving at ten!
sentences.translation: — Voy, printer **ishlamayapti**, mijoz esa soat o'nda keladi!

sentences.text: — Don't panic. **I'll call** the IT department right now.
sentences.translation: — Vahima qilma. Hozir IT bo'limiga **qo'ng'iroq qilaman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks. **Shall I** print the documents on the second floor instead?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Hujjatlarni ikkinchi qavatda **chop etaymi**?

sentences.text: — Good idea. **I'll come** with you and carry the copies.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. **Sen bilan boraman**, nusxalarni ko'tarishaman.

sentences.text: — And what **shall** we **do** about coffee? The machine is empty.
sentences.translation: — Qahva-chi, nima **qilamiz**? Apparat bo'm-bo'sh.

sentences.text: — Jasur says **he'll buy** some from the café downstairs.
sentences.translation: — Jasur pastdagi kafedan **olib kelishini** aytyapti.

sentences.text: — Perfect. **Will you** remind him to get some milk as well?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Unga sut ham olishni **eslatib qo'yasanmi**?

sentences.text: — Sure. And I promise **I won't** forget the presentation this time.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Bu safar taqdimotni **unutmayman**, so'z beraman.

sentences.text: — Ha! Right, the room is ready. **Shall we** go and wait downstairs?
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Xullas, xona tayyor. Pastga tushib **kutaylikmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, let's. **I'll** just **grab** my laptop and follow you.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yuring. Noutbukimni **olaman-u**, orqangizdan boraman.
